items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Did you meet Barney Bigard? No.

ctx.x: I don't remember Simeon being around then, no. But he came in later with Wilbur de Paris. Pops Foster? Pops Foster was there, yes. Yes. I remember I played with Pops Foster. In fact, I went with Wellstead up to Pops Foster's house. He was a delightful man. Very charming host.
Did you meet Barney Bigard? No. I thought in connection with your clarinet. I ran into him. Zooty.
Zooty. Yes. I've worked with Zooty at the Central Plaza. I remember that now.
